title: rosa canina var. medioxima
intro: Rosa canina var. medioxima, commonly known as the dwarf dog rose, is a small to medium-sized shrub species belonging to the Rosaceae family. The dwarf dog rose is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from digestive issues, inflammation, and anxiety due to its potential health benefits. The therapeutic actions of the dwarf dog rose include being a diuretic, astringent, and a mild laxative, which aid in detoxification, skin care, and regulating bowel movements. The bioactive constituents present in the dwarf dog rose include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
